$comment: Single source of truth for every legendary-effect NUMBER the builder maths use: the per-effect models consumed by src/lib/builder/combat-firepower-engine.ts and the catalog `effectMath` rows consumed by src/lib/builder/legendary-mod-catalog-seeds.ts. Keys are the catalog slugs derived by deriveSeedSlug() in legendary-mod-catalog-seeds.ts (SPECIAL effects carry their star, e.g. 'strength-3'). Defensive legendary reducers (Bolstering, Vanguard's, Sentinel's, armour Mutant's, Hardy, Unstoppable Monster) are NOT here: they live in defensive-perks.json, which owns the Patch 66 order of operations. Crit-fill numbers (Lucky Hit +15) live in src/lib/calculator/creation-engine-math.ts. Changing a value here changes the engine output and will move src/lib/builder/__fixtures__/firepower/goldens.json - regenerate those on purpose only.

fieldNotes.value: Primary magnitude. Damage kinds are fractions of base damage (0.75 = +75%); armor-pen is a percent (50 = 50%); flat-resist/max-hp/special are flat points.
fieldNotes.perUnit: Magnitude added per stack / addiction / mutation / crippled limb.
fieldNotes.maxStacks: Highest number of units counted before the cap applies.
fieldNotes.cap: Hard ceiling on the accumulated magnitude, in the same unit as `value`.
fieldNotes.catalogMath: Verbatim `effectMath` row for the builder catalog seeds (the simulation sandbox subset). Absent when the effect has no catalog row.
fieldNotes.confidence: verified = confirmed in game or in official notes; datamined = from a datamine Nathan reviewed; approximate = modelled, exact curve unpublished.

anti-armor.source: Anti-Armor 1-star: 'Ignores 50% of target's armor.' Penetration sources compound multiplicatively and are capped at 90% by creation-engine-math.

bloodied.source: Patch 70 datamine reviewed by Nathan 2026-09-18: up to +130% damage as health decreases, cap reached at 5% health (0.95 missing). Linear in missing health.

aristocrats.source: Aristocrat's weapon effect: up to +50% damage, scaling with caps carried and maxing at 29,000 caps. (The armour side is a 10% reflect at 40k caps since Patch 66 and is not modelled here.)

two-shot.source: Patch 70 datamine reviewed by Nathan 2026-09-18: Two Shot is +75% base damage (Patch 60 rebalance) plus the second projectile.

nocturnal.source: Nocturnal weapon effect: +50% damage at night; the builder also credits it while crouched/stealthed. Armour side gives Perception and Agility at night.

stalkers.source: Stalker's 1-star: +100% sneak-attack damage while crouched / stealthed.

junkies.source: Patch 70 datamine reviewed by Nathan 2026-09-18: +10% damage per addiction, up to +100% at 10 addictions (Patch 60 rebalance).

juggernauts.source: Juggernaut's 1-star: more damage the fuller your health bar. Modelled linearly from 75% health (0%) to 100% health (+25%); exact curve unpublished.

gourmands.source: Gourmand's 1-star: bonus damage while fed and hydrated. Modelled as +12% for the fed state plus +12% for the hydrated state; exact split unpublished.

mutants.source: Mutant's weapon effect: +5% damage per active mutation, counted to 5 mutations. The armour side is a damage reducer and lives in defensive-perks.json.

lucid.source: Lucid 1-star (ghoul): bonus damage while the Feral meter is high. Modelled as +40% at 80% lucidity and above.

furious.source: Gleaming Depths Onslaught rework: Furious 1-star gives +5% damage per Onslaught stack, to a maximum of 9 stacks.

adrenal.source: Adrenal 1-star (Burning Springs): +10% damage per kill while on a Kill Streak, max 10 kills.

rapid.source: Rapid 2-star: +25% weapon speed, i.e. a x1.25 fire-rate multiplier.

explosive.source: Explosive 2-star: bullets explode for 20% of the weapon's base damage in a small area, scaled by Demolition Expert.

hitmans.source: Hitman's 2-star: +25% damage while aiming down sights (outside V.A.T.S.).

steady.source: Steady 2-star: +25% damage while standing still / not sprinting.

powered.source: Powered 2-star: faster Action Point regeneration. Catalog sandbox models it as +5% AP regen.

poisoners.source: Patch 66 resist-mod pass: single-resist armour mods give 50 points (was 25). Poisoner's = Poison Resistance.

fireproof.source: Patch 66 resist-mod pass: single-resist armour mods give 50 points (was 25). Fireproof = Fire Resistance. (The Fireproof PERK was renamed Hardy in Patch 62 and is a reducer in defensive-perks.json.)

warming.source: Patch 66 resist-mod pass: single-resist armour mods give 50 points (was 25). Warming = Cryo Resistance.

hazmat.source: Patch 66 resist-mod pass: single-resist armour mods give 50 points (was 25). HazMat = Radiation Resistance.

overeaters.source: Patch 66: Overeater's is +40 maximum Health per piece, not a damage reducer.

unyielding.source: Unyielding 1-star: +3 to all SPECIAL except Endurance while at low health (ghouls are capped at +2).

vats-optimized.source: Patch 70 datamine reviewed by Nathan 2026-09-18: V.A.T.S. Optimized is -35% V.A.T.S. AP cost (x0.65). The old '25% LVC' name and value are obsolete.

severing.source: Patch 70 'The Slasher': Severing 4-star gives +50% damage against bleeding targets.

bullys.source: Bully's 4-star: +25% damage per crippled limb the target has (four limbs = +100%).

pounders.source: Gleaming Depths Onslaught rework: Pounder's 4-star (melee) gives +10% damage per Onslaught stack, to a maximum of 10 stacks.

berserkers.source: Patch 70 client data (SeventySix.esm 2026-09-16, build 1.7.26.13): Berserker's curve CT_Legendary_Weapon_DamageUnarmored: +50% at 0 damage resistance falling to +30% at 20, +17% at 40, +5% at 60 (non-linear; the cap is modelled, not the curve). Raw record: legendary-datamine-p70.json.

tarnished.source: Patch 70 client data (SeventySix.esm 2026-09-16, build 1.7.26.13): Tarnished curve HTO_CT_Legendary_Weapon_Tarnished_DMG: +120% at ~0% durability falling linearly (6 per 5%) to +0% at 100% durability; cap modelled. Raw record: legendary-datamine-p70.json.

raging.source: Patch 70 client data (SeventySix.esm 2026-09-16, build 1.7.26.13): Raging spell HTO_Legendary_Armor_RagingSpell: five fortify-damage effects of +5, +10, +15, +20, +25 for 10 seconds each, i.e. +5% per stack to +25%. This corrects the +3%/+15% earlier taken from a third-party guide (2026-09-22) that the client data does not support; whether stacks are per hit or per piece is not stated in the data. Raw record: legendary-datamine-p70.json.

haulers.source: Patch 70 client data (SeventySix.esm 2026-09-16, build 1.7.26.13): Hauler's effect AbPerkFortifyCarryWeight magnitude 30 per piece; five pieces give the +150 cap (the cap is the piece count times 30). Raw record: legendary-datamine-p70.json.

vampires.source: Patch 70 client data (SeventySix.esm 2026-09-16, build 1.7.26.13): Vampire's spell Legendary_VampireRegen: magnitude 1 for 2 seconds; the game's own text reads 'Restore 2% Health over 2 seconds when you Hit a Target'. Raw record: legendary-datamine-p70.json.
